data.description: A landmark Emaar polo resort blending equestrian heritage, luxury villas, and expansive green spaces.

data.answer:
Grand Polo Club & Resort is designed as a low-density, resort-style Emaar Polo community where open landscapes define daily life. Wide green corridors, polo fields, and pedestrian-friendly planning create a calm and private atmosphere rarely found in Dubai villa developments.

The community appeals to families, professionals, and high-net-worth buyers seeking a refined lifestyle anchored in wellness, exclusivity, and architectural quality, all within a secure, master-planned setting.

Real estate at Grand Polo Club & Resort focuses exclusively on villas and townhouses, positioning it as a premium destination for buyers seeking polo villas in Dubai with enduring value. Homes range from 3 to 5 bedrooms, offering generous layouts, landscaped surroundings, and privacy-driven designs.

Both buying and renting options are available, supported by strong demand for Emaar villas for sale in Dubai. Limited supply, brand credibility, and the unique equestrian theme contribute to long-term capital appreciation and rental stability.

more_info.question: Why Grand Polo Club & Resort Stands Out

data.answer:
Unlike traditional villa communities, Grand Polo Club and Resort is built around an equestrian core rather than added amenities. Polo fields, stables, and the polo club house form the heart of the masterplan, shaping the lifestyle rather than complementing it.

Combined with Emaar’s planning standards, extensive greenery, and wellness-focused design, this polo resort Dubai delivers a distinctive identity unmatched by other luxury communities.

Grand Polo Club & Resort Masterplan

Grand Polo Club & Resort is one of Dubai’s most expansive equestrian-led master developments, designed to balance luxury living with nature, scale, and long-term sustainability.

Community Scale & Masterplan Overview

  • A master-planned destination spanning 5.54 million sq.m
  • Over 1.59 million sq.m dedicated to open and landscaped spaces
  • An equestrian core covering 340,000 sq.m of polo fields and stables
  • A landmark polo club house with approximately 5,600 sq.m GFA
  • Around 1.56 million sq.m allocated for mixed-use development
  • 22 distinct residential clusters
  • Approximately 5,599 residences
  • Planned for an estimated 24,524 residents

These figures highlight the scale, exclusivity, and investment strength that define the Grand Polo Club and Resort Guide.

Gated Communities / Sub-Communities

Grand Polo Club & Resort is divided into multiple gated villa clusters, each offering a distinct lifestyle:

  • Equiterra & Equiterra 2 – Contemporary villas ranging from 3 to 5 bedrooms
  • Equestra – Architecturally refined villas emphasizing space and privacy
  • Chevalia Estate 2 – Premium 4 and 5-bedroom villas near equestrian zones
  • Selvara, Selvara 3 & Selvara 4 – Elegant 4-bedroom family villas

All sub-communities are landscaped, gated, and seamlessly connected to the polo club house.

Life in the Community

Life at Grand Polo Club & Resort unfolds at a measured, intentional pace shaped by nature and space. Mornings begin with quiet walks along landscaped trails, views across open green corridors, and the distant rhythm of equestrian life, a setting that encourages wellness as part of everyday routine rather than a scheduled activity.

The community is designed for families and homeowners seeking depth, privacy, and continuity. With low-density planning and a strong sense of place, it supports long-term living over transient stays, offering a refined residential environment where calm, connection, and quality define daily life.

Location and Nearby Areas

Grand Polo Club & Resort is set within Dubai’s emerging luxury growth corridor, surrounded by a mix of established and developing communities. The location strikes a balance between privacy and accessibility, allowing residents to enjoy spacious living while remaining well-connected to the city.

Key destinations are within a reasonable drive, including Downtown Dubai (approximately 30–35 minutes), Dubai Marina (around 35–40 minutes), and Dubai International Airport (about 30 minutes). Nearby districts provide access to retail centers, schools, healthcare facilities, and lifestyle amenities that support comfortable day-to-day living without the density of inner-city areas.

Transport & Connectivity

Grand Polo Club & Resort is well connected through Dubai’s major highway network, supporting smooth daily commuting and efficient movement across the city. Designed with road-based accessibility in mind, the community offers easy access to key business districts, lifestyle hubs, and surrounding residential areas.

The development benefits from direct connectivity to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) and Emirates Road (E611), while internal arterial roads ensure low congestion and seamless circulation within the masterplan. This connectivity enhances the appeal of the community for homeowners seeking long-term accessibility and convenience.

Public Transportation

While Grand Polo Club & Resort is primarily designed for private vehicle use, public transportation options are available within short driving distances. Bus services operate in nearby residential and commercial areas, connecting residents to wider public transport networks across Dubai.

Taxi services and ride-hailing platforms such as Careem and Uber are commonly used and readily available, providing flexible mobility for residents who prefer not to drive daily.

Supermarkets

Residents of Grand Polo Club & Resort can access a variety of well-established supermarket chains across nearby residential districts and major road corridors. Grocery options serving the wider area include Carrefour, Union Coop, and Choithrams, which cater to everyday household needs. Premium grocery retailers such as Spinneys and Waitrose are available within nearby lifestyle and mixed-use hubs, offering a wider selection of fresh and specialty products.

Shopping Malls & Retail Destinations

Several shopping and retail destinations are accessible within a reasonable driving distance of Grand Polo Club & Resort. City Centre Me’aisem serves as a convenient community mall, offering retail outlets, dining options, and daily services. For a larger destination experience, Ibn Battuta Mall provides international brands, entertainment venues, and family-friendly facilities. Lifestyle-focused retail, dining, and leisure options are also available at Dubai Hills Mall, which is reachable via major highways.

This mix allows residents to enjoy both neighborhood convenience and destination-level retail without high-density activity immediately surrounding the community.

Schools and Nurseries

Families living at Grand Polo Club & Resort benefit from access to a range of established schools and early learning centers located across nearby communities. Educational options within driving distance include institutions offering British, IB, and other international curricula, such as schools operated by GEMS Education, along with American and international curriculum schools in surrounding districts. A number of nurseries and early childhood centers also operate within the wider catchment area, supporting long-term family residency.

Clinics & Hospitals

Healthcare services are available across nearby residential and commercial areas, with access to medical providers such as Mediclinic and Aster Clinic, along with other multi-specialty clinics and hospitals. Veterinary clinics and pet care services are also accessible, making the area suitable for families with pets and supporting everyday healthcare needs.

Places of Worship

Places of worship are accessible from Grand Polo Club & Resort across nearby residential districts and main road corridors. Several mosques serve surrounding communities in Dubai Investment Park and Dubai South, while churches and temples in Jebel Ali and central Dubai can be reached within reasonable driving distance, supporting the area’s diverse population.

Life at Grand Polo Club & Resort is shaped by outdoor living, wellness, and equestrian culture. Within the masterplan, landscaped walking paths, green corridors, and views across polo fields create a calm, resort-like rhythm to daily life. Beyond the community, residents can access leisure and cultural destinations, including Expo City Dubai, which features open public spaces, cultural pavilions, fitness areas, cafés, and year-round family events.

Additional lifestyle options are available across nearby districts, including Dubai South and Jebel Ali, offering gyms, sports facilities, and community parks that complement the outdoor-focused environment of the development.

Restaurants and Dining

Dining options near Grand Polo Club & Resort range from casual cafés to established dining destinations located within nearby retail and lifestyle hubs. Expo City Dubai features a growing selection of cafés and restaurants, while City Centre Me’aisem offers family-friendly dining options and everyday eateries.

For a wider variety of international cuisines and sit-down restaurants, residents can visit Ibn Battuta Mall, which is home to numerous global dining brands. This provides choice without introducing high-density activity into the residential setting.

Beaches / Outdoor Activities

While Grand Polo Club & Resort is not a beachfront community, its location allows convenient highway access to Dubai’s coastline. Popular waterfront destinations such as JBR Beach and Kite Beach can be reached for weekend outings and leisure activities.

Closer to home, the community’s own open landscapes, walking trails, and equestrian spaces support daily outdoor activity without the need to travel far.

Hotels / Accommodation Options

A selection of hotels and serviced accommodation options are located within nearby districts, supporting visiting guests and business travelers. These include hotels in Expo City Dubai, such as Rove Expo City, as well as hospitality options across Dubai South and the Dubai Parks and Resorts area.

These hotels serve visitors conveniently while preserving the privacy and residential nature of Grand Polo Club & Resort.

Landmarks and Attractions

The defining landmark of Grand Polo Club & Resort is its extensive polo fields and equestrian facilities, which form the heart of the masterplan and distinguish it from other villa communities in Dubai. Beyond the development, residents can easily access major attractions such as Expo City Dubai and prominent Emaar-developed lifestyle destinations across the city via key road networks.
Together, these attractions reinforce the community’s identity as a refined polo resort Dubai offering both exclusivity and access to Dubai’s wider cultural and lifestyle scene.

Are Emaar Polo villas at Grand Polo Club & Resort ideal for families?

Yes. Polo villas Dubai buyers choose at Grand Polo Club & Resort are ideal for families seeking space, privacy, and a calm environment. As an Emaar Polo community, it offers landscaped green areas, walking trails, and a low-density, villa-only setting suitable for long-term family living.

Who is the developer of Grand Polo Club & Resort?

Grand Polo Club & Resort is developed by Emaar Properties, one of Dubai’s most trusted master developers, known for creating premium lifestyle destinations and large-scale residential communities across the city.

Is Grand Polo Club & Resort an Emaar Polo Club branded project?

Yes. Grand Polo Club & Resort is an Emaar Polo Club branded master-planned community. The development is built around an equestrian lifestyle, featuring polo fields, stables, and a signature polo club house that defines the identity of this exclusive polo resort Dubai.

What types of properties are available in Grand Polo Club & Resort?

The community offers a collection of luxury polo villas Dubai buyers seek, including 3, 4, and 5-bedroom villas across multiple residential clusters. All homes are designed to reflect the equestrian-inspired concept and the premium standards associated with Emaar Polo developments.

Where is Grand Polo Club & Resort located in Dubai?

Grand Polo Club & Resort is located near Emirates Road (E611) and Expo Road (E77), within Dubai’s emerging luxury growth corridor. Its location provides convenient access to Dubai South, Expo City Dubai, and major highways connecting to key destinations across the city.

What amenities are available at Grand Polo Club & Resort?

Amenities at Grand Polo Club & Resort include expansive polo fields, equestrian facilities, a central polo club house, landscaped green corridors, jogging and walking trails, community parks, and wellness-focused outdoor spaces, all designed to support the lifestyle of a premium polo resort Dubai.

What are the main attractions within Grand Polo Club & Resort?

The main attractions include the equestrian facilities, championship polo fields, and the iconic Emaar Polo Club environment. These features form the heart of the community and distinguish Grand Polo Club & Resort from other villa developments in Dubai.

What is the payment plan for Grand Polo Club & Resort villas?

Payment plans for Grand Polo Club & Resort villas vary by phase and villa collection. As an Emaar Polo development, payment structures are typically construction-linked. For the most accurate and updated payment plan details, contacting an authorized sales partner is recommended.

Why invest in Grand Polo Club & Resort?

Investing in Grand Polo Club & Resort offers strong long-term potential due to Emaar’s brand strength, limited supply of polo villas Dubai, a unique equestrian-led lifestyle, and growing demand for luxury villa communities. These factors position it as a compelling investment within Dubai’s premium polo resort segment.

Yes. This FAQ section forms part of the Grand Polo Club and Resort Guide, designed to help buyers and investors understand the lifestyle, location, property options, and investment appeal of this exclusive Emaar Polo community.

data.content:
Grand Polo Club & Resort is a landmark master-planned destination by Emaar Properties, redefining luxury living through an equestrian-led vision. Built around world-class polo fields and a signature polo club house, the community blends heritage, nature, and modern architectural elegance.

The development features exclusive polo villas and townhouses that Dubai buyers and tenants seek, with spacious 3, 4, and 5-bedroom homes across multiple residential clusters. Residents can both buy and rent villas, making the community attractive to both end users and long-term investors.

Positioned as a true polo resort in Dubai, Grand Polo Club & Resort stands out for its scale, wellness-focused planning, and elite Emaar Polo Club lifestyle, offering privacy, connectivity, and prestige within one cohesive masterplan.

nodes.title: Selvara 4
nodes.about:
Selvara 4 by Emaar Properties introduces an exclusive collection of 4-bedroom villas within the prestigious Grand Polo Club & Resort. Inspired by timeless equestrian heritage, the community combines contemporary architecture with tranquil surroundings, offering exceptional living and strong potential for high capital appreciation. Buyers can secure their villa with a convenient 10% down payment.

Selvara 4 at Grand Polo Club & Resort is thoughtfully planned around lifestyle and well-being, featuring a curated retail promenade, a state-of-the-art gymnasium, a tranquil pool terrace, and a yoga pavilion. Elegant interiors, natural materials, and beautifully landscaped surroundings create a welcoming environment where comfort, connection, and modern family living come together.
